sub_graphs.title: EIP-7199: Linter Validation Workflow
sub_graphs.description: Models the governance workflow for EIP linting rules - this is a meta-governance EIP with no runtime protocol impact

nodes.label: Pull Request Submitted
nodes.description: A pull request modifying an EIP has been submitted

nodes.label: Run EIP Linter
nodes.description: Automated linter checks the pull request for formatting issues

nodes.label: Check if Status Changed
nodes.description: Determine if the PR changes the EIP's status field

nodes.label: Status Change Detected
nodes.description: PR modifies the EIP status (e.g., Draft to Review)

nodes.label: No Status Change
nodes.description: PR does not modify the EIP status

nodes.label: Enforce All Lint Rules
nodes.description: Require all lint errors to be fixed, including untouched lines

nodes.label: Enforce Touched Lines Only
nodes.description: Only require lint fixes for lines modified by the PR

nodes.label: PR Blocked by Linter
nodes.description: PR cannot be merged due to lint errors

nodes.label: PR Passed Lint Check
nodes.description: PR meets linting requirements and can proceed

edges.label: No lint errors in touched lines

external_entities.name: EIP Contributor
external_entities.description: Developer or community member submitting changes to an EIP document

ambiguities.text: The specification uses 'SHOULD NOT' which is not a strict requirement, leaving implementation discretion to tooling maintainers.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'SHOULD NOT' implies strong recommendation but allows for exceptions in edge cases at maintainer discretion.

ambiguities.text: The EIP does not specify which linting rules apply to 'status changes' versus 'other changes'.
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume all existing linting rules apply uniformly; the distinction is only about scope (touched vs untouched lines).

implicit_assumptions.description: EIP editors and tooling maintainers will implement the relaxed linting scope as specified.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Contributors continue facing barriers to micro-contributions, discouraging community participation.

implicit_assumptions.description: This meta-governance EIP has no impact on Ethereum protocol runtime behavior.
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: N/A - this is a governance process EIP only, not a protocol change.
